Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You receive an email to apply and further when you get a visa, the host insititution will send a link to do so.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: contacting the inbound secretary of the host institution

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer:
Not very as the process is slow. 
I ended up having being registered for units that had the exam after my departure from Australia, why I needed to change units upon arrival and could only choose from the rest of the litter.
I was in contact with the inbound counselor and she was the one to register me for the classes with the exams outside of my exchange.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be careful with the date of the exam of the units you enroll in.
